# Controlled Lattice continuation — 2026-10-04

## Purpose and boundaries

The human authorized completing the explained plan. Test whether a residual-state correction adds next-session information beyond simple forecasts, and why a smaller error appears if it does. This is a numerical component for the Post-owned first equity wording pilot; it does not duplicate that policy or account engine. The first wording arm and later financial benchmark remain separate. Native repair, data qualification and predictive usefulness are separate conclusions.

Use the existing adjusted-close snapshot and acquired market bytes. Historical identity, receipt and adjustment vintages are unqualified. Inspected 2024/2025 stays development; protected final tests remain locked. New future observations and an economic edge are evidence requirements, not promised implementation results.

## Mechanism and alternatives

Hypothesis: a temporarily displaced cumulative return of a stock and its fitted hedge reverses when their relationship is stable. Alternatives: the apparent state is an integrated unpredictable return series; a permanent company/relationship shift makes catch-up inappropriate; historical drift explains any forecast improvement; or abstention reduces forecast magnitude without discovering predictability.

Predictions and contradictions are registered before this new fit. The state term should add on the same basket beyond zero, its own historical mean, own-return AR and formation drift. A permanent shift should expose the harmful pull toward an old level. Generated mean-reversion gains validate conditional mathematics only. Splitting calibration checks whether the estimated dynamics and correction direction agree; it is a price-history proxy for stability, not qualified company news.

## Target, arms and controls

Every setting uses the same 126-session formation ending before the largest 80-session calibration block. Form the signed MST peer hedge once for each date/stock; preserve its weights and gross normalization. Forty, sixty and eighty sessions estimate state on that identical basket. Changing calibration cannot change the formation cutoff, hedge or realized target. Normalize forecast and realized additive basket returns by the same sum of absolute hedge weights.

Registered arms: zero, same-basket historical mean, same-basket return AR, formation drift, state correction alone, drift plus correction, and split-stability-gated drift plus correction. Retain inva
